observations: Three photos show a hairdryer and hairstreamer set on a tiled floor.
The device has a central blue and grey spherical chamber with a black base and two extendable arms with nozzles.
One arm has a visible power cord attached.
The device appears to be a salon-style hairstyling tool, possibly a hairdryer and steam generator combo.
No brand or model name is visible on any part of the device in any photo.
The photos are watermarked with 'AYOMAYOWA OLANIKEKUN' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.evidence: The device shown in all three photos has the appearance of a hairdryer and hairstreamer, with a central chamber and extendable arms with nozzles.

risks.risk: The device may not work or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the device powered on, with steam or airflow produced, and the nozzles functioning.

risks.risk: The power cord may be damaged or frayed, posing a safety hazard.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the power cord and plug, showing no cuts, fraying, or exposed wires.

risks.risk: The device may be missing parts or accessories (e.g., attachments, remote, or stand).
risks.proof: Photo showing all included components laid out, including any attachments or accessories.

proof_requests: Close-up of the rating plate, usually on the back or underside of the unit.
Video of the device in operation, showing steam or airflow.
Close-up photo of the power cord and plug.
Photo showing all included accessories and attachments.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
